items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I know him pretty well. We were both pallbearers at Paul's funeral.

ctx.x: Well, a Chicago piano player. Well, yes. Or Schoble.

Yeah, Schoble and Carl. Forgotten I know him pretty well. We were both pallbearers at Paul's funeral. But fundamentally, the Chicagoans, two from Lower Indiana, two from Lower Illinois, farm boys, were playing as a unit in Chicago before the other people were playing.

Frank Snyder tells me about their meeting, Brunus, over here on North Avenue in Halsted, where they'd come to Jim, finding some people that they could work with. And he said that's where he met Brunus long before they joined together to form the New Orleans Rhythm Kings.
